changelog: v1.5.0: Architectural Rebuild — Six-phase upgrade making Jarvis selective + self-aware. Phase 1 closes the post-mortem→vector→Scholar learning loop (sentry & manual closes were silently skipping it). Phase 2 reveals the system was already profitable (+$233 / 56% WR / PF 4.73) and identifies the real bleed: tiny exits (74.6% of wins <0.5R) + bleed-hour overtrading. Phase 3 tightens swarm selectivity: confidence-override bug removed, Sentinel min confidence 50→60, BUY R/R floor 1.0→1.5, bleed-hour filter (12-19 UTC, configurable IST AM/PM). Phase 4 embeds a 21-lesson trading curriculum into vector memory (semantic recall verified). Phase 5 fixes the let-winners-run mechanic (dollar profit target → 50% partial close + breakeven SL + 2% trailing on remainder, was 100% close). Phase 5.5 Scanner SCORE honesty (scaled by confluence% so disagreement is legible) + 1H/4H/1D dots + hover popover in both scanner widgets. Phase 6 campaign R/R parity (rejects impossible-target campaigns + skips bad-R/R deploys). Integration audit fixes 7 ghost features including TradingView Bridge (auto-connect + UI pill + auto-navigate verified end-to-end), Sentry brainActivity logging, /api/backtest HTTP route, Goals card reading wrong collection. Startup manifest now logs every engine init.
